items.description: Signed G Nick Broeker to the practice squad.
Claimed DB Isaac Yiadom off waivers from Washington.
Designated RB Raheim Sanders to return from injured reserve.
Suspended RB J.K. Dobbins one game for conduct detrimental to the team. Designated RB Tyler Badie to return from injured reserve.
Reinstated DE Micah Parsons from the physically unable to perform list.
Waived LB Milo Eifler from injured reserve. Signed DB Derrick Canteen to the practice squad. Released LB Dominique Hampton from the practice squad.

Waived T Charlie Heck. Signed QB Shane Buechele from Buffalo's practice squad and DE Carl Lawson from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed DE Caden Curry on injured reserve. Signed TE Sean McKeon and DE Cam Sample to the practice squad.
Placed FB Ben VanSumeren on injured reserve. Signed OT Fred Johnson from the practice squad to the active roster.
Signed DT David Blay and DB A.J. Woods to the practice squad. Released T Amari Kight and DB Greedy Vance from the practice squad.
Designated LB Ronnie Harrison to return from injured reserve.
Signed T Tristan Leigh to the practice squad. Released LB Josh Ross from the practice squad.
Signed TE Patrick Murtagh to the practice squad.
Signed DE Dawuane Smoot from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed DB Greg Newsome on injured reserve. Signed C Geno VanDeMark to the practice squad.
Waived DT Payton Page. Released DT Isaiahh Loudermilk from the practice squad.
Waived C Jake Majors. Signed LB Chance Campbell from the practice squad to the active roster.
Signed WR Brandon Smith to the practice squad.
Waived WR Theo Wease. Signed RB Ian Wheeler to the practice squad. Released TE Josiah Deguara from the practice squad.
Released DE Robert Beal from the practice squad.

Waived DB Avery Smith. Signed DB Trevon Diggs and T Bobby Hart from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed T Chase Lundt from Buffalo's practice squad. Placed RB George Holani on injured reserve. Signed WR Jacob De Jesus and QB Adrian Martinez to the practice squad.
Released QB Cooper Rush from the practice squad.
Released RB Craig Reynolds from the practice squad.
Signed DT C.J. Ravenell to the practice squad.
Waived QB Kedon Slovis and WR LaJohntay Wester.
Released LB Christian Harris. Signed S Jammie Robinson from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed CB Terell Smith to the practice squad.
Signed DB Marlen Sewell to the practice squad. Released QB Miller Moss from the practice squad.
